task: Add a company-profile edit UI to MebelDocs AI using the existing GET/PUT API and preserve immutable/system fields.
acceptance_criteria: A profile page loads the existing company profile and handles the not-found state.
The operator can edit the allowed business fields and save them through PUT /api/company-profile.
System fields and invoice numbering are not sent or silently overwritten by the UI.
Loading, validation, error and saved states are visible in Russian on desktop and mobile.
Tests, TypeScript check and production build pass; ROADMAP and SESSION_NOTES are updated.
non_scope: No API, domain schema, storage or authentication redesign.
No production deployment or real company-data mutation.
No new dependency, external service, tax rule or multi-tenant change.

triage_input.summary: Implement the existing MebelDocs AI company-profile edit UI roadmap item

pre_registered_human_label.rationale: The UI handles sensitive business-profile fields but changes no real data during validation, uses an existing local API and remains a bounded single-repository feature.
